name: Surrey
pointBasis: Immutable WUP 2025 queue point copied unchanged in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate adjustment.
registryBasis: The official City of Surrey GIS ArcGIS REST service exposes a lots polygon layer and returned parcel polygons from anonymous bounded queries. This is city GIS evidence, not a claim that it is the legal land-title authority or that all city parcels are covered.
blocker: Public geometry is evidenced, but runtime remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.

source.operator: City of Surrey GIS / Engineering Department
source.serviceCrs: Current layer metadata reports NAD_1983_UTM_Zone_10N (NAD83 CSRS/GVRD), while bounded requests explicitly used inSR=4326 and outSR=4326; GeoJSON coordinates were observed in [longitude, latitude] order.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official City of Surrey COSMOS/GIS discovery, layer metadata inspection, one exact-point lookup at the immutable WUP point, and one bounded envelope lookup near that point.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three safe polygon features returned from a bounded envelope; the exact-point request returned two records with identical geometry and MSLINK, one with a null FOLIO and one with FOLIO 6283000009.

queries.query: Surrey British Columbia official cadastral parcel map GIS property parcels ArcGIS
queries.result: Attempt 3 first-party discovery re-found the City of Surrey Maps & COSMOS and GIS pages, public viewer, and official ArcGIS REST lots layer; current metadata identifies polygon geometry, safe parcel fields, and NAD83/UTM Zone 10N source CRS.

queries.query: Surrey BC carte cadastrale parcelles SIG officiel
queries.result: Attempt 3 French-language discovery returned the same official City of Surrey COSMOS/GIS sources; the city's public source is English and no separate French local registry source was found.

requests.outcome: Direct first-party page fetch was denied by the research environment; this is a route limitation, not evidence of source absence. Search discovery and prior retained first-party response identify the page.
Current public viewer shell returned; bootstrap.js is the Sencha application entrypoint and ArcGIS JS API 4.21 is referenced. No login or credential wall encountered.
Current ArcGIS layer metadata returned; lots layer is polygon, supports GeoJSON, exposes safe parcel identifiers plus geometry, and reports NAD83/UTM Zone 10N source CRS.
Returned two records with identical Polygon geometry and MSLINK 3551 at the unchanged WUP point; only safe fields were requested. No absence inference is made.
Returned three Polygon features and exceededTransferLimit=true; three unchanged safe samples retained. This bounded response is not citywide completeness evidence.

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: Returned a local polygon response at the unchanged WUP coordinate; duplicate records were observed and not treated as two distinct parcels.

remainingUncertainty: Current layer metadata reports NAD83/UTM Zone 10N; requests explicitly requested EPSG:4326 output and returned plausible WGS84 GeoJSON coordinates. The envelope response was transfer-limited, the service's legal-authority status is not established, and freshness, complete citywide coverage, and stable adapter semantics remain unverified. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.

requests.outcome: First-party GIS page identifies the City's ArcGIS Enterprise/COSMOS GIS function.
Redirected to https://cosmos.surrey.ca/external/; no login wall or CAPTCHA encountered.
Confirmed lots polygon layer, GeoJSON support, maxRecordCount 2000, and NAD83/UTM Zone 10N metadata; no unsafe values were requested or retained.
Unchanged WUP point returned two Polygon records with identical geometry and MSLINK 3551; duplicate records were not counted as two parcels.

attempt3.scopeLimit: Existing sample remains three full polygons maximum; no new polygon was needed. This does not establish citywide coverage, legal-title authority, freshness, or adapter readiness.
